description: This Java source file defines the ServiceBridge class, which manages the connection and communication between the voice recognition service and the activity in an Android application. It handles starting voice recognition, notifying results, and managing service connections.

classes.name: ServiceBridge
classes.description: Manages service connection and communication for voice recognition.

classes.name: ServiceBridge.ConnectionRequest
classes.description: Handles connection requests for starting recognition.

classes.name: ServiceBridge.ConnectionResponse
classes.description: Handles connection for delivering recognition results.

methods.name: startVoiceRecognition
methods.description: Initiates voice recognition by binding to the service and setting up callbacks.

methods.name: notifyResult
methods.description: Notifies the service of a recognition result.

methods.name: setServiceCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback to be invoked when recognition results are available.
